title: dice.rolled payload
description: A roll made by the mechanics library (contracts.md C-03, api-contracts.md 2.3.5). Published before combat.decided; the cause is the player action or round.closed the seed derives from.

index.description: Index of the roll inside its cause event; part of the seed.

seed.description: Seed(causeEventID, roll.index) = first 8 bytes of SHA-256, big endian.
